passages.note: Section 12 of HB 1296 removes Indiana's license-to-carry requirement for handguns.
Behning is listed as a co-author of HB 1296, the firearms-matters bill eliminating the carry license.
passages.actor_quote: Rep. Steve Bartels, Rep. Robert Behning, Rep. Bruce Borders

passages.note: Behning voted Yea on adoption of the conference committee report on HB 1296.

rows.reasoning: Behning co-authored and voted Yea on HB 1296 (2022), whose operative text provides that a person 'under state or federal law is not required to obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana.' Per the gun-policy annex, for a state officeholder a law removing the state's carry license meets both clauses of rung 5, 'Repeal major gun restrictions and let adults carry a firearm without a permit.'
